name: alyr-platform
description: ALYR web, prototype, native, and shared product contracts.

scripts.check: npm run check:shared && npm run check:api-contract && npm run check:supabase:static && npm run check:web && npm run check:mobile-prototype && npm run check:native && npm run check:ios-preview
scripts.check:api-contract: npm run generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/src/generated/api.ts
scripts.check:web: npm run test:domain --workspace=asset-continuity-web && npm run test:server --workspace=asset-continuity-web && npm run test:ui --workspace=asset-continuity-web -- --maxWorkers=2 --testTimeout=15000 && npm run test:sites --workspace=asset-continuity-web && npm run build --workspace=asset-continuity-web
scripts.check:mobile-prototype: npm run build --workspace=asset-continuity-mobile && npm run test:sites --workspace=asset-continuity-mobile
scripts.check:native: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@alyr/native && npm run test --workspace=@alyr/native && npm run config:check --workspace=@alyr/native
scripts.check:ios-preview: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview && npm run test:contract --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview && npm run config:check --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview && npm run bundle:ios --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview
scripts.dev:native: npm run build:shared && npm run start --workspace=@alyr/native
scripts.dev:ios-preview: npm run build:shared && npm run start:lan --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview
